potential_clients.summary: Elgin Dental Implants is a young practice under a year old that has been struggling with fragmented marketing across four vendors, achieving poor ROI and lacking unified tracking. Flowco initially presented a consolidated marketing solution with HIPAA-compliant EMR integration to replace their scattered vendor setup. In the follow-up meeting, the discussion moved to specifics including a $3,500 monthly service plus $2,000 ad spend with Open Dental integration, addressing their Spanish-speaking patient base with no current Spanish SEO, and proposing Google Local Service Ads and AI-powered lead nurturing. The practice aims to scale from 148 reviews to 30-50 new reviews monthly, with a decision expected mid-November and a simple dashboard delivery targeted for October.
action_items: Provide detailed information on Google Local Service Ads to Elgin Dental Implants for their review and consideration.

Continue developing a client-facing marketing dashboard that consolidates data from multiple ad platforms and Google properties, ensuring HIPAA compliance and ease of use, with delivery targeted for October.
Explore and develop call center service capabilities to complement Flow Company's existing marketing services.
Review and decide which two underperforming marketing firms to drop and communicate changes internally.
Reconnect with Elgin Dental Implants in mid-November to discuss readiness for engagement.

meetings_digest.title: Monique Reyes and Flow Company
key_points: Fragmented Marketing Vendors: Elgin uses four marketing companies leading to scattered efforts and subpar 2-3x ROI over six months.
Consolidation Proposal: Flowco offers unified marketing with expert teams and HIPAA-compliant EMR integration for real-time tracking.
Tracking and Reporting Issues: Current mix of Excel, Slack, and AI dashboards causes poor visibility; Flowco aims for a single unified dashboard.
New Practice Challenges: Elgin Dental Implants started under a year ago, experimenting with seven marketing firms, showing need for stable strategy.
Integration Complexity: Middleware mirrors EMR scheduling, overcoming common dental API issues to ensure accurate lead-to-patient data flow.
